# WO-2026-08-13-04 — LANE A: turn 39 read lines into a shop Warwick can actually receive

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ WARWICK'S MORNING OUTCOME, and this lane is the spine of it.** The known 39-line photograph must go
> *"through the completed system"* and reach: **39/39 source-list accounting → reconciled against
> household/catalogue truth → quantities resolved under the authorised rules → genuine uncertainties dealt
> with honestly → final shopping list created → sorted by BRAND → READY for the supervised browser session
> to pick up."*
> ⛔ *"NOT manually rescued. NOT reconstructed by Larry from the photograph. NOT created by database
> surgery. **The actual production path must produce it.**"*

**AC1 — 39/39 ACCOUNTED FOR. Nothing silently dropped, nothing silently invented.**
Every source line ends in exactly one of: **resolved** · **skipped** (explicitly, with reason) ·
**unresolved and routed** to Cockpit. **A line that simply disappears is the defect this AC exists to
catch** — assert the accounting closes and make the assertion fail if it does not.

**AC2 — RECONCILIATION IS CONSERVATIVE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS.** Warwick:
> *"duplicate observations of one physical source line collapse; genuinely different purchases with similar
> names MUST NOT collapse."*
⛔ **Do NOT use confidence as the authority to elect a survivor.** The existing protections for **Yazoo
strawberry vs chocolate · Twix ice cream vs biscuit bars · Arla vs ASDA milk** must remain effective —
**pin all three by test**, because they have already been silently merged once in this build.

**AC3 — PROVENANCE STAYS FOUR-WAY DISTINCT, and never leaks.** Warwick:
> *"PHOTO is not REGULARS. REGULARS is not RULE. RULE is not HUMAN. HUMAN is not PHOTO."*
The arithmetic: **photo source truth + separately justified household additions − explicit skips = final
shopping plan.**
⛔ *"Do not contaminate PHOTO truth merely to make the final plan balance."* A Regular added because the
household normally buys it is **REGULARS**, and it is added **separately and visibly**, never folded into
the photo count.

⚠️ **AND THE NEW FACT THAT CHANGES YOUR DESIGN:** vision now ships with **NO structural anti-phantom
mechanism** — the positional gate was proven not to work and was turned off. **1–2 catalogue-valid
inventions per run reach you.** **Reconciliation is now the only place an unsupported PHOTO line can be
caught, and you may not assume vision caught it.** Do what you honestly can here — and **say plainly what
you cannot**, rather than implying a defence that does not exist.

**AC4 — QUANTITY, through the ACTUAL list-creation path.** ⛔ Warwick: *"Do not merely unit-test a parser in
isolation and call quantity done."* Demonstrate on the real produced list:
no purchase count → **1** · `item x4` → **4** · `4 x item` → **4** · *Richmond 16 sausages* → **1 pack of
the identified 16-count product** · *Ariel Pods 33* → **1 pack of the 33-count product** · **explicit
conflicting observations → Cockpit uncertainty, NEVER a guessed quantity.**
**Prove the completed 39-line list contains no pack-size-as-quantity failure.**

**AC5 — THE FINAL LIST, DURABLE AND SORTED BY BRAND.** A real artefact, not a log line: product count, item
count, each line carrying its final identity, quantity, provenance and substitute policy. **Sorted by
BRAND**, as Warwick specified.

**AC6 — THE BROWSER-READY HANDOFF.** Prepared and verified so that *"there is no further archaeology
required"* when the supervised runner picks it up. It must be **durable, executable, sorted by brand,
carrying correct quantities, correct final product identities and appropriate substitute policy.**
⛔ **NO browser run. NO trolley. NO checkout. NO payment. NO slot. NO order action of any kind.** Warwick:
*"The browser session itself waits on correct product truth."*

**AC7 — GENUINE UNCERTAINTY IS ROUTED, NEVER GUESSED.** *"A genuine uncertain line may go to Cockpit. **A
silently wrong line may not.**"* Ideally zero unresolved before browser-ready; **an honest non-zero is
better than a guessed zero.**

**AC8 — mutation-prove the deterministic invariants**: the accounting closure, the both-directions
reconciliation, and the quantity rule. **A gate no test can fail is not a gate.**

**AC9 — project cost before the first run.** Ceiling **$2.00**. Vision runs cost ~$0.35 each. Report
projected vs actual.

⛔ **NO ACCEPTANCE, no end-to-end claim, no live proof.** Warwick: *"Until then, no claim that AsdAIr is
accepted."*
